commands.name: Heal
commands.description: Full health.

commands.name: Give armour
commands.description: Full body armour.

commands.name: Heal and armour
commands.description: Full health and full body armour.

commands.name: Kill player
commands.description: Wasted.

commands.name: Wanted level +1
commands.description: One more wanted star.

commands.name: Wanted level -1
commands.description: One wanted star less.

commands.name: Wanted level max
commands.description: Five stars.

commands.name: Clear wanted level
commands.description: The police lose interest.

commands.name: Add money
commands.description: Adds money to the current character (a negative amount takes it away).

commands.name: Set money
commands.description: Sets the current character's money.

commands.name: Random clothing
commands.description: Puts the player in a random outfit.

commands.name: Jail player
commands.description: Locks the player in a cage for a while.

commands.name: Spawn vehicle
commands.description: Spawns a vehicle next to the player. Any model name works, not only the ones in the list.

commands.name: Spawn random vehicle
commands.description: Spawns a random vehicle next to the player.

commands.name: Spawn random vehicle and drive
commands.description: Puts the player in the driver's seat of a random vehicle.

commands.name: Delete player vehicle
commands.description: Removes the vehicle the player is in (or just got out of).

commands.name: Repair vehicle
commands.description: Fixes and cleans the player's vehicle.

commands.name: Explode vehicles nearby
commands.description: Blows up the vehicles around the player (not the player's own).

commands.name: Spawn ramp
commands.description: Drops a stunt ramp in front of the player.

commands.name: Random vehicle tuning
commands.description: Random mods, paint, wheels and neon on the player's vehicle.

commands.name: Full vehicle tuning
commands.description: Best engine, brakes, gearbox, armour and turbo, plus a new paint job.

commands.name: Give weapon
commands.description: Gives the player a weapon with ammo. Any weapon name works (e.g. pistol, WEAPON_RPG).

commands.name: Give random weapon
commands.description: Gives the player a random weapon with ammo.

commands.name: Set ammo
commands.description: Sets the ammo of the weapon in the player's hands.

commands.name: Remove weapons
commands.description: Takes all of the player's weapons.

commands.name: Spawn attackers
commands.description: Hostile peds that hunt the player.

commands.name: Arm attackers
commands.description: Gives every spawned attacker a better gun.

commands.name: Remove attackers
commands.description: Removes every attacker, monkey and moto spawned by GiftDeck.

commands.name: Moto cops
commands.description: Police on motorbikes come after the player.

commands.name: Moto bandits
commands.description: Armed bikers come after the player.

commands.name: Monkey killers
commands.description: Armed chimps that attack the player.

commands.name: Spawn pigeons
commands.description: A flock of pigeons around the player.

commands.name: Spawn poodles
commands.description: Poodles around the player.

commands.name: Spawn random animals
commands.description: Random animals around the player.

commands.name: Set time
commands.description: Sets the clock (hour 0 to 23).

commands.name: Set weather
commands.description: Changes the weather.

commands.name: Earthquake
commands.description: The ground shakes and cars jump for a while.

commands.name: Teleport to LS Airport
commands.description: Los Santos International Airport.

commands.name: Teleport to Maze Bank top
commands.description: The roof of the Maze Bank Tower.

commands.name: Teleport to Fort Zancudo
commands.description: Inside the army base. Expect company.

commands.name: Teleport to Mount Chiliad
commands.description: The top of Mount Chiliad.

commands.name: Teleport to a random place
commands.description: Somewhere random on the map.

commands.name: Teleport to waypoint
commands.description: The waypoint set on the map, if there is one.

commands.name: Skydive
commands.description: Sends the player high into the sky with a parachute.

commands.name: Launch player up
commands.description: Throws the player (or their car) into the air.

commands.name: Drunk
commands.description: Wobbly walk, blurry screen and a shaky camera for a while.

commands.name: Nothing
commands.description: Does nothing: for testing that gifts reach the game.
